name: notify
title: Notifications
description: Tells you what the workspace needs without opening it: a digest of overdue and due-today tasks, and a nudge when an agent changes something. Sends to Telegram; with no bot token it prints what it would have sent, so you can see the wording first.

config.label: Telegram bot token
config.help: From @BotFather. Leave empty to preview messages without sending.

config.label: Telegram chat id
config.help: Message your bot once, then open https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates to find it.

config.label: Send task digest (yes/no)
config.help: Overdue and due-today tasks, on the schedule above. Default yes.

config.label: Notify on agent edits (yes/no)
config.help: When something changes the document over the API rather than in the app. Default yes.

config.label: Only this basket id
config.help: Optional. Limits the digest to one project's tasks.
